# LightSim component reference

Every part in LightSim's library: its id (the `type` for model_edit's `add`), its ports (`id`: name, kind, direction) and its parameters (`key`: label, unit, default, limits). Values are given in the unit listed; there is no unit conversion.

## Vehicle (`vehicle.body`)

Category: Vehicle. Domain: mechanical.

Longitudinal vehicle body: mass, road load and road grade. Road load comes from the drag coefficient × frontal area and the Wheels' rolling resistance, or, with Road Load From set to coefficients, from A + B·v + C·v² with v in km/h, as coast-down tests publish it (WLTP f0, f1, f2; EPA's lbf, lbf/mph and lbf/mph² values × 4.448, × 2.764 and × 1.717); then Cd, frontal area and the Wheels' rolling resistance are not used. Drag follows the air density the Ambient block sets (1.204 kg/m³ at 20 °C and 101.325 kPa without one), and so does C, which is taken at 1.204 kg/m³. Coast-down (target) coefficients already hold the drag of the gears the wheels turn in neutral: with Coefficients Include Driveline Losses ticked, the final drives, differentials and transfer cases run lossless (gearboxes and motors keep their losses; a coast-down holds only the axle's spin losses, so this leaves out a little); untick it for dyno-set coefficients. The road grade (rise over run, in %) sets the slope angle θ = atan(grade / 100): the weight pulls the car back with m·g·sin θ, and the normal load (rolling resistance, tyre grip) is m·g·cos θ. Load transfer: with a Centre of Gravity Height h, a load of m·(a + g·sin θ)·h/L moves from the front axle to the rear, with L the Wheelbase and a the acceleration over the previous solver step (so the loads are one 10 ms step behind; drag is taken to act at ground height). Each Wheel's Axle setting says which axle it is on, and the Wheels' load shares give the static split, so the centre of gravity's position follows from them. The Downforce Area (CzA) adds ½·ρ·CzA·v², at the air density the Ambient block sets, split between the axles by the Front Aero Balance; a negative CzA is lift. Downforce adds to the Wheels' rolling resistance, but not to coefficient A. An axle that would carry less than nothing lifts: it carries nothing, the other axle carries the rest, and the run warns. With a height and an area of 0 (the defaults) every wheel keeps its share of the weight. In a lap case the car also corners: a lateral acceleration a_y moves m·a_y·h from the inner to the outer wheels, split between the axles as the weight is (the front axle's static share of the weight takes that share of it), over each axle's Front or Rear Track Width. Front Axle Load and Rear Axle Load are the normal loads on the Front and on the Rear Wheels. Binds to all Wheel elements automatically — no canvas wiring needed for the body itself. Pair it with a Driver element to follow a speed profile.

Ports:
- `sig_grade_in`: Road Grade (signal input, -)
- `sig_speed`: Vehicle Speed (signal output, km/h)
- `sig_distance`: Distance (signal output, m)
- `sig_load_front`: Front Axle Load (signal output, N)
- `sig_load_rear`: Rear Axle Load (signal output, N)

Parameters:
- `mass_kg`: Vehicle Mass [kg], default 1800 kg; > 0
- `cd`: Drag Coefficient (Cd), default 0.28; ≥ 0
- `frontal_area_m2`: Frontal Area [m²], default 2.2 m²; ≥ 0
- `road_load_mode`: Road Load From, default `Drag and rolling resistance`; one of Drag and rolling resistance, Coefficients A/B/C
- `road_load_a_N`: Road Load A (f0) [N], default 212 N
- `road_load_b_N_per_kmh`: Road Load B (f1) [N/(km/h)], default 0 N/(km/h)
- `road_load_c_N_per_kmh2`: Road Load C (f2) [N/(km/h)²], default 0.0286 N/(km/h)²
- `abc_include_driveline_losses`: Coefficients Include Driveline Losses, default on
- `initial_speed_kmh`: Initial Speed [km/h], default 0 km/h; ≥ 0
- `cg_height_m`: Centre of Gravity Height [m], default 0 m; ≥ 0
- `wheelbase_m`: Wheelbase [m], default 2.7 m; > 0
- `downforce_cza_m2`: Downforce Area (CzA) [m²], default 0 m²
- `aero_balance_front_pct`: Front Aero Balance [%], default 50 %; ≥ 0 and ≤ 100
- `track_front_m`: Front Track Width [m], default 1.55 m; > 0
- `track_rear_m`: Rear Track Width [m], default 1.55 m; > 0

## Driver (`driver.driver`)

Category: Vehicle. Domain: signal.

Speed-following driver (PI controller). Wire a target-speed profile into Target Speed and the Vehicle's speed into Actual Speed; the driver outputs a traction command in [-1, 1] and a friction-brake command, blending recuperation (motor generator quadrant, battery charge limit) before the brakes per the Recuperation Weight.

Ports:
- `sig_target_in`: Target Speed (signal input, km/h)
- `sig_speed_in`: Actual Speed (signal input, km/h)
- `sig_traction_cmd`: Traction Command (signal output, -)
- `sig_brake_cmd`: Brake Command (signal output, -)
- `sig_accel_pedal`: Accel Pedal (raw) (signal output, -)
- `sig_brake_pedal`: Brake Pedal (raw) (signal output, -)

Parameters:
- `driver_kp`: P Gain [1/(km/h)], default 0.35 1/(km/h); ≥ 0
- `driver_ki`: I Gain [1/(km/h·s)], default 0.08 1/(km/h·s); ≥ 0
- `regen_weight_pct`: Recuperation Weight [%], default 80 %; ≥ 0 and ≤ 100

## HV Battery Pack (`battery.generic`)

Category: Battery. Domain: electrical.

Equivalent-circuit battery pack: OCV(SOC) lookup table with series resistance R0 and an optional RC pair for voltage transients (RC disabled when either RC parameter is 0). SOC counts the charge that flows (amp-hours) and the OCV table is read at that SOC. Charge Capacity sets the amp-hours; left at 0 they come from the Usable Capacity at the OCV table's mean voltage, so a full-to-empty discharge gives out the Usable Capacity. Coulombic Efficiency is the share of the charging current that is stored (Li-ion cells store about 99.9 %, so it defaults to 100 %). Charging power is limited by the maximum charge power. The Output Power Limit caps the power the terminals give (volts × amps), less the Power Limit Margin: the motors get what is left after the other loads, and recuperation is not limited. With a limit or a Voltage Class set, the run summary checks the terminal power, averaged over the Power Check Window, against the limit, and the highest pack voltage (open-circuit at 100 % SOC, or at the terminals while recuperating) against the Voltage Class; 0 turns either off. With Hold Power to Limit off, the power is only checked, not held.

Ports:
- `pos`: Positive Terminal (+) (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `neg`: Negative Terminal (−) (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_soc`: SOC (signal output, %)
- `sig_voltage`: Terminal Voltage (signal output, V)
- `sig_current`: Current (signal output, A)
- `sig_power`: Discharge Power (signal output, kW)

Parameters:
- `capacity_kWh`: Usable Capacity [kWh], default 60 kWh; > 0
- `capacity_Ah`: Charge Capacity (0 = from Usable Capacity) [Ah], default 0 Ah; ≥ 0 and ≤ 100000
- `coulombic_efficiency_pct`: Coulombic Efficiency (charging) [%], default 100 %; > 0 and ≤ 100
- `ocv_table`: Open-Circuit Voltage [V], default table
- `internal_resistance_ohm`: Series Resistance R0 [Ω], default 0.08 Ω; ≥ 0
- `rc_resistance_ohm`: RC Pair Resistance R1 [Ω], default 0 Ω; ≥ 0
- `rc_time_constant_s`: RC Pair Time Constant [s], default 0 s; ≥ 0
- `max_charge_power_kW`: Max Charge Power [kW], default 120 kW; ≥ 0
- `initial_soc_pct`: Initial SOC [%], default 90 %; > 0 and ≤ 100
- `min_soc_pct`: Minimum SOC [%], default 10 %; > 0 and ≤ 100
- `output_power_limit_kW`: Output Power Limit (0 = none) [kW], default 0 kW; ≥ 0
- `power_limit_margin_pct`: Power Limit Margin [%], default 0 %; ≥ 0 and ≤ 100
- `power_limit_window_s`: Power Check Window (0 = instant) [s], default 0 s; ≥ 0 and ≤ 60
- `power_limit_enforced`: Hold Power to Limit (off = check), default on
- `voltage_class_V`: Voltage Class (0 = none) [V], default 0 V; ≥ 0

Presets: Formula Student Electric

## E-Motor (`motor.emotor`)

Category: E-Drive. Domain: electrical.

Electric machine with voltage-dependent full-load torque map, power-loss map (motor + inverter) and drag torque. The loss map covers every loss while the inverter is powered, spin losses at zero torque included; the drag torque applies only when the motor coasts unpowered (zero command or no supply). Motoring and generating (recuperation) quadrants; generator limit mirrors the full-load map scaled by the Q4 scale parameter. Traction command input is a normalized demand in [-1, 1]. Maximum Speed (0 = the full-load curve's last speed point): the drive torque falls to zero over the last 2 % below it, and above it the inverter is off, so the motor gives no drive torque and no recuperation. Each table axis has an outside-the-data setting: Error stops the run, Clamp holds the edge value, Linear extends the edge slope.

Ports:
- `pos`: Positive Terminal (+) (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `neg`: Negative Terminal (−) (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `shaft`: Mechanical Shaft (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_demand_in`: Traction Command (signal input, -)
- `sig_speed`: Shaft Speed (signal output, 1/min)
- `sig_torque`: Shaft Torque (signal output, N·m)
- `sig_mech_power`: Mechanical Power (signal output, kW)
- `sig_elec_power`: Electrical Power (signal output, kW)
- `sig_losses`: Losses (signal output, kW)

Parameters:
- `full_load_torque`: Full-Load Torque [N·m], default table
- `power_loss`: Power Loss (Motor + Inverter) [kW], default table
- `drag_torque`: Drag Torque (unpowered) [N·m], default table
- `max_speed_rpm`: Maximum Speed (0 = full-load curve's last point) [1/min], default 0 1/min; ≥ 0
- `inertia_kgm2`: Rotor Inertia [kg·m²], default 0.045 kg·m²; ≥ 0
- `q4_torque_scale_pct`: Generator Torque Limit Scale [%], default 100 %; ≥ 0 and ≤ 200

## DC-DC Converter (`controller.dcdc`)

Category: E-Drive. Domain: electrical.

DC-DC converter with constant conversion efficiency. Unidirectional: draws at Terminal A, supplies at Terminal B. When Terminal B feeds a bus with a battery, the converter runs at its power setpoint (parameter or signal) and the battery balances the rest — the fuel-cell hybrid pattern.

Ports:
- `a_pos`: Input + (HV in) (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `a_neg`: Input − (HV in) (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `b_pos`: Output +  (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `b_neg`: Output −  (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_setpoint_in`: Power Setpoint (signal input, kW)
- `sig_power_in`: Power In (signal output, kW)
- `sig_power_out`: Power Out (signal output, kW)
- `sig_losses`: Losses (signal output, kW)

Parameters:
- `efficiency_pct`: Conversion Efficiency [%], default 97 %; > 0 and ≤ 100
- `output_voltage_V`: Output Voltage [V], default 350 V; > 0
- `power_setpoint_kW`: Power Setpoint (battery-bus mode) [kW], default 0 kW

## Voltage Source (`electric.voltage_source`)

Category: Base Electric. Domain: electrical.

Ideal DC voltage source. Supplies unlimited power at a fixed voltage.

Ports:

- `neg`: Negative Terminal (−) (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_voltage`: Voltage (signal output, V)

## Electric Node (`electric.node`)

Category: Base Electric. Domain: electrical.

Ideal electrical junction / bus bar. All connected terminals share one voltage; power balances across the branches.

Ports:

- `t2`: Terminal 2 (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `t3`: Terminal 3 (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `t4`: Terminal 4 (electrical bidirectional, kW)

## Power Consumer (`electric.constant_drive`)

Category: Base Electric. Domain: electrical.

Constant electrical load (auxiliaries, HVAC, LV net). Draws a fixed power, optionally overridden by a signal input.

Ports:
- `pos`: Positive Terminal (+) (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `neg`: Negative Terminal (−) (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_demand_in`: Power demand (signal input, kW)

## Ground (`boundary.ground`)

Category: Base Electric. Domain: electrical.

Electrical ground / return rail reference. Carries no power in the solve; connect the low side of electrical components here.

Ports:
- `t1`: Terminal 1 (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `t2`: Terminal 2 (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `t3`: Terminal 3 (electrical bidirectional, kW)

## Shaft (`mech.shaft`)

Category: Driveline. Domain: mechanical.

Rigid shaft. Passes torque/speed through with optional mechanical efficiency and rotational inertia.

Ports:
- `flange_a`: Flange A (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `flange_b`: Flange B (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_power`: Transmitted Power (signal output, kW)

Parameters:
- `efficiency_pct`: Mechanical Efficiency [%], default 100 %; > 0 and ≤ 100
- `inertia_kgm2`: Inertia [kg·m²], default 0.01 kg·m²; ≥ 0

## Final Drive (`mech.final_drive`)

Category: Driveline. Domain: mechanical.

Single-ratio reduction gear. Output torque = input torque × ratio × efficiency (direction-aware); output speed = input speed / ratio.

Ports:
- `flange_in`: Flange In (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `flange_out`: Flange Out (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_power`: Transmitted Power (signal output, kW)
- `sig_speed_out`: Output Speed (signal output, 1/min)

Parameters:
- `ratio`: Transmission Ratio, default 9.7; > 0
- `inertia_in_kgm2`: Moment of Inertia In [kg·m²], default 0.01 kg·m²; ≥ 0
- `inertia_out_kgm2`: Moment of Inertia Out [kg·m²], default 0.02 kg·m²; ≥ 0
- `efficiency_pct`: Efficiency [%], default 97 %; > 0 and ≤ 100

## Differential (`mech.differential`)

Category: Driveline. Domain: mechanical.

Splits one mechanical input to two outputs. Unlocked (open): equal torque to both sides, output speeds free (input speed = mean of outputs). Locked: both outputs forced to the same speed, torque split follows the grip on each side.

Ports:
- `flange_in`: Flange In (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `flange_out_a`: Flange Out A (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `flange_out_b`: Flange Out B (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_torque_a`: Torque Out A (signal output, N·m)
- `sig_torque_b`: Torque Out B (signal output, N·m)
- `sig_speed_in`: Input Speed (signal output, 1/min)

Parameters:
- `locked`: Locked, default off
- `ratio`: Ratio, default 1; > 0
- `efficiency_pct`: Efficiency [%], default 98 %; > 0 and ≤ 100
- `inertia_kgm2`: Inertia [kg·m²], default 0.015 kg·m²; ≥ 0

## Mechanical Node (`mech.node`)

Category: Driveline. Domain: mechanical.

Rigid mechanical junction. All connected flanges rotate at the same speed; torques sum. Use one per wheel corner to attach brake and wheel to the same axle end.

Ports:
- `f1`: Flange 1 (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `f2`: Flange 2 (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `f3`: Flange 3 (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `f4`: Flange 4 (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_speed`: Node Speed (signal output, 1/min)

## Wheel (`propulsion.wheel`)

Category: Wheels & Brakes. Domain: mechanical.

Wheel with longitudinal slip tire model: traction force = slip stiffness × slip × normal load, saturated at μ × normal load. Its static normal load is the Vehicle mass × this wheel's load share (× the cosine of the road's slope angle); the shares of all connected wheels are scaled to add up to 100 %, so together they always carry the whole vehicle. The Normal Load adds this wheel's part of its axle's load transfer and downforce (the Vehicle's Centre of Gravity Height and Downforce Area), split between the wheels of an axle by their shares: set Axle to Rear on the rear wheels. With a Load Sensitivity dμ/dFz, μ changes with the normal load: μ + dμ/dFz × (normal load − Nominal Load Fz0), never below 0 (tyres lose grip as the load rises, so it is usually negative, a few hundredths per kN; an Fz0 of 0 is this wheel's share of the weight on level ground). Lap cases also use the Lateral Friction μ_y (0: the same as μ) and the Friction Ellipse Exponent n, which says how much grip is left one way while the tyre uses some the other: (Fx/Fx,max)^n + (Fy/Fy,max)^n ≤ 1, where 2 is an ellipse. Rolling resistance acts on the vehicle body; it is not used when the Vehicle takes its road load from coefficients A/B/C.

Ports:
- `shaft`: Mechanical Shaft (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_speed`: Wheel Speed (signal output, 1/min)
- `sig_slip`: Longitudinal Slip (signal output, -)
- `sig_force`: Traction Force (signal output, N)
- `sig_torque`: Drive Torque (signal output, N·m)
- `sig_normal_load`: Normal Load (signal output, N)

Parameters:
- `radius_m`: Wheel Radius [m], default 0.33 m; > 0
- `inertia_kgm2`: Inertia [kg·m²], default 1.2 kg·m²; ≥ 0
- `vehicle_load_share_pct`: Vehicle Load Share [%], default 25 %; > 0 and ≤ 100
- `axle`: Axle, default `Front`; one of Front, Rear
- `mu`: Friction Coefficient μ, default 1; ≥ 0
- `slip_stiffness`: Slip Stiffness, default 10; > 0
- `rolling_resistance`: Rolling Resistance Coeff., default 0.012; ≥ 0
- `mu_lateral`: Lateral Friction μ_y, default 0; ≥ 0
- `mu_load_sensitivity_per_kN`: Load Sensitivity dμ/dFz [1/kN], default 0 1/kN
- `mu_nominal_load_N`: Nominal Load Fz0 [N], default 0 N; ≥ 0
- `friction_ellipse_exponent`: Friction Ellipse Exponent, default 2; ≥ 1 and ≤ 10

## Brake (`mech.brake`)

Category: Wheels & Brakes. Domain: mechanical.

Friction brake. Applies braking torque = command × maximum torque, opposing rotation (no torque reversal at standstill).

Ports:
- `flange`: Flange (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_demand_in`: Brake Command (signal input, -)
- `sig_torque`: Brake Torque (signal output, N·m)

Parameters:
- `max_torque_Nm`: Maximum Brake Torque [N·m], default 1400 N·m; ≥ 0
- `inertia_kgm2`: Inertia [kg·m²], default 0.18 kg·m²; ≥ 0

## Propeller (`propulsion.propeller`)

Category: Propulsion. Domain: mechanical.

Quadratic mechanical load: torque = reference torque × (speed / reference speed)². Placeholder for aircraft/marine loads until a full aircraft body model exists.

Ports:
- `shaft`: Mechanical Shaft (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_speed`: Shaft Speed (signal output, 1/min)
- `sig_shaft_power`: Shaft Power (signal output, kW)

Parameters:
- `torque_ref_Nm`: Torque at Reference Speed [N·m], default 500 N·m; ≥ 0
- `ref_speed_rpm`: Reference Speed [1/min], default 2000 1/min; > 0
- `inertia_kgm2`: Inertia [kg·m²], default 2.5 kg·m²; ≥ 0

## Driving Task (`signal.driving_task`)

Category: Driver & Signals. Domain: signal.

Time-based target-speed profile (piecewise-linear). Pick a standard cycle in Drive Cycle, or type 't:speed' pairs separated by ';' in Profile. Wire the output to the Driver's Target Speed input.

Ports:
- `sig_demand`: Target Speed (signal output, km/h)

Parameters:
- `cycle`: Drive Cycle, default ``
- `profile`: Profile (t:speed; …), default `0:0; 30:50; 120:50; 150:80; 300:80; 330:30; 480:30; 540:0; 600:0`
- `scale_pct`: Scale [%], default 100 %; ≥ 0
- `repeat`: Repeat Profile, default off

## Constant (`signal.constant`)

Category: Driver & Signals. Domain: signal.

Constant signal source.

Ports:
- `sig_out`: Output (signal output, -)

Parameters:
- `value`: Value, default 50

## Script (Function) (`signal.script`)

Category: Driver & Signals. Domain: signal.

User-written Python function evaluated every solver step (≤ 10 ms), or at its Sample Time if that is longer; the step is passed in as dt. Add named signal input/output ports in the Properties panel; the step() function receives inputs and a persistent state dict and returns a dict of output values. Use for hybrid control strategies, custom recuperation logic, signal math, etc.

Ports: none until you add signal ports to the part.

Parameters:
- `code`: Python Code, default code
- `sample_time_s`: Sample Time (0 = solver step) [s], default 0 s; ≥ 0

## Monitor (`signal.monitor`)

Category: Driver & Signals. Domain: signal.

Display-only monitor. Add signal input ports and wire any signals into them; during and after a run the Monitors panel shows live readouts and sparklines for every wired input.

Ports: none until you add signal ports to the part.

## Ambient (`boundary.ambient`)

Category: Boundaries. Domain: thermal.

Ambient air. Its temperature and pressure set the air density for the Vehicle's drag, rho = p / (R · T) with R = 287.05 J/(kg·K) for dry air; no wiring needed. Without an Ambient the density is 1.204 kg/m³ (20 °C, 101.325 kPa); in a model with several, the first one counts. There is no thermal solver yet: no part's temperature follows it.

Ports:
- `thermal`: Thermal Port (thermal bidirectional, °C)

Parameters:
- `temperature_C`: Temperature [°C], default 20 °C; > -273.15 and ≤ 1000
- `pressure_kPa`: Pressure [kPa], default 101.325 kPa; > 0

## Combustion Engine (`engine.combustion`)

Category: ICE Powertrain. Domain: mechanical.

Internal combustion engine: full-load torque curve, drag (motoring) torque, and a fuel-consumption map (speed × torque → kg/h). The full-load curve and fuel map are brake (net, flywheel) values, as on a datasheet; the drag torque applies only while the engine is not fired: switched off, out of fuel, in overrun fuel cut-off (zero throttle above the re-entry speed) or above the full-load curve's last speed (rev limiter). Built-in idle governor holds idle speed at zero throttle. Below the full-load curve's first speed (starting, stalling) a fired engine gives that point's torque and burns that point's fuel (the start-up rule), so the curve and the fuel map are read only between its first and last speed. Enable input allows hybrid start/stop control (unwired = always on); consumes from the Fuel Tank automatically.

Ports:
- `shaft`: Mechanical Shaft (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_throttle_in`: Throttle (signal input, -)
- `sig_on_in`: Enable (signal input, -)
- `sig_speed`: Engine Speed (signal output, 1/min)
- `sig_torque`: Engine Torque (signal output, N·m)
- `sig_fuel_rate`: Fuel Rate (signal output, kg/h)
- `sig_power`: Mechanical Power (signal output, kW)

Parameters:
- `full_load_torque`: Full-Load Torque [N·m], default table
- `drag_torque`: Drag Torque (unfired) [N·m], default table
- `fuel_map`: Fuel Consumption Map [kg/h], default table
- `idle_speed_rpm`: Idle Speed [1/min], default 800 1/min; > 0
- `fuel_cut_reentry_rpm`: Fuel Cut-Off Re-Entry Speed [1/min], default 1100 1/min; ≥ 0
- `inertia_kgm2`: Inertia [kg·m²], default 0.18 kg·m²; ≥ 0

## Fuel Tank (`fuel.tank`)

Category: ICE Powertrain. Domain: fluid.

Fuel reservoir. Combustion engines draw from it automatically; when it runs dry the engine shuts off. Its density turns the fuel burnt into litres and its CO₂ factor (3.17 kg per kg for petrol) into the CO₂ emissions in the run summary. One tank per model.

Ports:
- `sig_level`: Fill Level (signal output, %)
- `sig_mass`: Fuel Mass (signal output, kg)

Parameters:
- `capacity_kg`: Capacity [kg], default 45 kg; > 0
- `initial_fill_pct`: Initial Fill [%], default 90 %; ≥ 0 and ≤ 100
- `density_kg_per_l`: Fuel Density [kg/l], default 0.745 kg/l; > 0
- `co2_kg_per_kg`: CO₂ per kg of Fuel [kg/kg], default 3.17 kg/kg; ≥ 0

## Gearbox (`mech.gearbox`)

Category: Driveline. Domain: mechanical.

Multi-speed gearbox. The ratio table maps gear number → ratio; the Gear Select signal picks the active gear (nearest defined gear wins, unwired = default gear). A shift takes effect at the solver step (≤ 10 ms) in which Gear Select changes.

Ports:
- `flange_in`: Flange In (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `flange_out`: Flange Out (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_gear_in`: Gear Select (signal input, -)
- `sig_gear`: Active Gear (signal output, -)
- `sig_speed_out`: Output Speed (signal output, 1/min)

Parameters:
- `ratios`: Gear Ratios, default table
- `default_gear`: Default Gear, default 1; ≥ 1
- `efficiency_pct`: Efficiency [%], default 97 %; > 0 and ≤ 100
- `inertia_in_kgm2`: Moment of Inertia In [kg·m²], default 0.015 kg·m²; ≥ 0
- `inertia_out_kgm2`: Moment of Inertia Out [kg·m²], default 0.02 kg·m²; ≥ 0

## Clutch (`mech.clutch`)

Category: Driveline. Domain: mechanical.

Friction clutch (smooth Coulomb model). Transmits up to engagement × maximum torque across the slipping interface; under load a small residual slip remains even when fully engaged. Unwired engagement = fully closed.

Ports:
- `flange_a`: Flange A (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `flange_b`: Flange B (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_engage_in`: Engagement (signal input, -)
- `sig_torque`: Transmitted Torque (signal output, N·m)
- `sig_slip_speed`: Slip Speed (signal output, 1/min)

Parameters:
- `max_torque_Nm`: Maximum Torque [N·m], default 300 N·m; ≥ 0

## Transfer Case (`mech.transfer_case`)

Category: Driveline. Domain: mechanical.

Center torque split for AWD/multi-axle drivelines. Unlocked: torque splits per the split parameter with free output speeds (planetary-style speed weighting); locked: both outputs forced to the same speed. Each output can feed an axle differential.

Ports:
- `flange_in`: Flange In (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `flange_out_a`: Flange Out A (front) (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `flange_out_b`: Flange Out B (rear) (mechanical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_torque_a`: Torque Out A (signal output, N·m)
- `sig_torque_b`: Torque Out B (signal output, N·m)
- `sig_speed_in`: Input Speed (signal output, 1/min)

Parameters:
- `locked`: Locked, default off
- `torque_split_a_pct`: Torque Split to Output A [%], default 50 %; ≥ 0 and ≤ 100
- `ratio`: Ratio, default 1; > 0
- `efficiency_pct`: Efficiency [%], default 98 %; > 0 and ≤ 100
- `inertia_kgm2`: Inertia [kg·m²], default 0.02 kg·m²; ≥ 0

## Fuel Cell Stack (`fuelcell.stack`)

Category: Fuel Cell. Domain: electrical.

PEM fuel cell stack: polarization curve (stack voltage vs. current) with a current limit; hydrogen consumption follows electrical energy. Draws from the Hydrogen Tank automatically. Typically feeds the HV bus through a DC-DC converter running at a power setpoint.

Ports:
- `pos`: Positive Terminal (+) (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `neg`: Negative Terminal (−) (electrical bidirectional, kW)
- `sig_voltage`: Stack Voltage (signal output, V)
- `sig_current`: Stack Current (signal output, A)
- `sig_power`: Electrical Power (signal output, kW)
- `sig_h2_rate`: H₂ Consumption (signal output, kg/h)

Parameters:
- `polarization`: Polarization Curve [V], default table
- `max_current_A`: Maximum Current [A], default 400 A; > 0
- `h2_per_kwh_g`: Specific H₂ Consumption [g/kWh], default 55 g/kWh; ≥ 0

## Hydrogen Tank (`fuel.h2_tank`)

Category: Fuel Cell. Domain: fluid.

Pressurized hydrogen storage. Fuel cells draw from it automatically; when empty the stack shuts down. One tank per model.

Ports:
- `sig_level`: Fill Level (signal output, %)
- `sig_mass`: H₂ Mass (signal output, kg)

Parameters:
- `capacity_kg`: Capacity [kg], default 5 kg; > 0
- `initial_fill_pct`: Initial Fill [%], default 95 %; ≥ 0 and ≤ 100

## PID Controller (`control.pid`)

Category: Driver & Signals. Domain: signal.

Generic PID feedback controller with output clamping and anti-windup, evaluated every solver step (≤ 10 ms), or at its Sample Time if that is longer. Use it for custom control loops without writing a script.

Ports:
- `sig_setpoint_in`: Setpoint (signal input, -)
- `sig_feedback_in`: Feedback (signal input, -)
- `sig_out`: Output (signal output, -)

Parameters:
- `kp`: Proportional Gain, default 1
- `ki`: Integral Gain [1/s], default 0 1/s
- `kd`: Derivative Gain [s], default 0 s
- `out_min`: Output Minimum, default -1
- `out_max`: Output Maximum, default 1
- `sample_time_s`: Sample Time (0 = solver step) [s], default 0 s; ≥ 0

## Lookup Table (`signal.lookup`)

Category: Driver & Signals. Domain: signal.

Applies a 1D or 2D lookup table to its input signal(s) — no-code signal shaping (e.g. pedal maps, recuperation weighting).

Ports:
- `sig_x_in`: Input X (signal input, -)
- `sig_y_in`: Input Y (2D mode) (signal input, -)
- `sig_out`: Output (signal output, -)

Parameters:
- `mode`: Mode, default `1D`; one of 1D, 2D
- `table_1d`: 1D Table, default table
- `table_2d`: 2D Table, default table
- `sample_time_s`: Sample Time (0 = solver step) [s], default 0 s; ≥ 0

## Road Profile (`signal.road_profile`)

Category: Driver & Signals. Domain: signal.

Road grade profile over distance (or time), piecewise-linear 'x:grade%' pairs. Wire the grade output to the Vehicle's Road Grade input; in distance mode it follows the Vehicle's distance automatically when unwired.

Ports:
- `sig_distance_in`: Distance (signal input, m)
- `sig_grade`: Road Grade (signal output, -)

Parameters:
- `profile`: Profile (x:grade%; …), default `0:0; 500:3; 1500:3; 2000:0; 3000:-3; 4000:0`
- `mode`: Profile Axis, default `distance`; one of distance, time
- `repeat`: Repeat Profile, default off

## Race Track (`track.lap`)

Category: Driver & Signals. Domain: signal.

The line a lap case (case Kind: Lap) drives: its curvature against distance (1/radius; + turns left, − right) and its elevation. A lap case finds the fastest speed along it about every metre, as a quasi-steady-state lap simulation does: in each corner the speed the tyres' lateral grip allows (with the Vehicle's downforce and load transfer, and each Wheel's load sensitivity), then full acceleration out of it and the latest braking into the next, within the tyres' friction ellipse, the E-Motors' full-load curves through the gears and the battery's deliverable power and Output Power Limit. The motors, gears, brakes and battery then drive that speed trace through the same models as a drive cycle, for the energy and the channels. The results are estimates for an ideal driver on the given line: no transients, suspension, yaw or tyre slip, and ideal brake balance. Only E-Motor drivelines: a lap case refuses Combustion Engines and Clutches, holds Gearboxes in their gear and commands the motors itself. Layouts drawn for LightSim, not official layouts: Autocross, a 979 m closed lap (straights up to 78 m, a slalom on 10 m cones, corners of 6 m radius or more, 3 sectors); Skidpad, a right then a left circle on the lane centre, 9.125 m radius (with 2 laps, lap 2's Sector 1 and Sector 2 are the timed right and left circles); Acceleration 75 m, an open straight. They follow Formula Student Rules 2026 v1.1 (FSG) D 4.1, D 5.1.1, D 6.1 and D 7.1; FSUK and FSAE may differ, check the current season's rules. Custom uses the Curvature and Elevation tables (paste them from a spreadsheet; from a logged lap, curvature = lateral acceleration / speed², smoothed), Closed Circuit and the Sector Ends. Lap 1 starts at the Vehicle's Initial Speed (no faster than its first corner allows), each later lap at the speed the one before ended with. The Limit channel says what held the car back: 1 cornering grip, 2 traction grip, 3 motor, 4 battery, 5 Output Power Limit, 6 braking. The case's Duration, Step and Pacing do not apply to lap cases; its Store every does.

Ports:
- `sig_lap_distance`: Lap Distance (signal output, m)
- `sig_lap`: Lap (signal output, -)
- `sig_curvature`: Curvature (signal output, 1/m)
- `sig_long_accel`: Longitudinal Acceleration (signal output, g)
- `sig_lat_accel`: Lateral Acceleration (signal output, g)
- `sig_limit`: Limit (signal output, -)
- `sig_x`: Map X (signal output, m)
- `sig_y`: Map Y (signal output, m)
- `sig_elevation`: Elevation (signal output, m)

Parameters:
- `layout`: Layout, default `Autocross`; one of Autocross, Skidpad, Acceleration 75 m, Custom
- `laps`: Laps, default 1; ≥ 1 and ≤ 500
- `curvature_table`: Curvature (Custom) [1/m], default table
- `elevation_table`: Elevation (Custom) [m], default table
- `closed`: Closed Circuit (Custom), default on
- `sector_ends`: Sector Ends (Custom, m; …), default ``
